t: LAP Ubertas tilt LED downlights are a versatile lighting solution, supplied in a convenient 10-pack. These integrated 4W LED downlights provide 420 lumens and feature a polished chrome twist-lock bezel for straightforward fitting. Ideal for domestic indoor applications such as kitchens, living rooms, and hallways, they offer adjustable lighting to suit various needs. The colour temperature is tunable between 2700K warm white, 4000K cool white, and 6000K daylight, allowing users to select the desired ambiance. Dimmable functionality provides further control over light intensity, while the tilt feature enables precise light direction. Installation is simplified with an easy wire connection.
b: Tiltable Design Directs Light Precisely Where Needed
